decisions.reason: Explains build-before-bump baked 0.3.6 into the v0.3.7 client, causing a self-update comparison, and recommends bump-before-build plus emitted constant verification while retaining mirror checks.
Uses PNG 200, SVG unsupported 404, and disk whitelist evidence to show the client refreshed but the running host route closure was stale until host restart.
Compares clean source and read result against spliced persisted model-visible text and clean reread to localize corruption upstream of the plugin, not in the disk SVG.
Designs the ordered disk asset route, XML-validated session payload, sandboxed no-script iframe, and explicit error chain without passing malformed payload through unchecked.
Explains decoding concatenated Zstandard frames in order to recover the JSONL splice, compare it with source, report upstream, and prevent recurrence with build/version and plane-specific probes.

caps.reason: The report rejects bump-after-build, mirror-only fixes, browser-refresh-only host updates, editing the clean SVG, and unchecked or scripted SVG rendering.
